context: Checks the executor rewrite follows the nx-plugin-authoring executor rules: thin entrypoint, async I/O, structured result, package notation and declared outputs.

checklist.name: Business logic moved out of the entrypoint
checklist.description: The transformation logic is moved into separate composable library functions and the entrypoint only delegates.

checklist.name: Entrypoint is thin
checklist.description: The rewritten `executor.ts` contains orchestration only, not the long parsing and transformation block.

checklist.name: Synchronous reads replaced
checklist.description: `fs.readFileSync` is replaced with `await fs.promises.readFile` or an equivalent async call.

checklist.name: Synchronous writes replaced
checklist.description: `fs.writeFileSync` is replaced with an asynchronous write.

checklist.name: Structured error handling
checklist.description: Failures are caught and reported with a clear message rather than thrown unhandled.

checklist.name: Returns success object
checklist.description: The executor returns `{ success: boolean }` instead of a bare boolean.

checklist.name: Success false on failure
checklist.description: The error path returns `{ success: false }`.

checklist.name: Package notation in target
checklist.description: The target uses `@acme/tools:transform` instead of a relative path.

checklist.name: Outputs declared
checklist.description: The target declares `outputs` such as `{options.outputPath}` or the output file path so Nx can cache it.

checklist.name: Executor stays deterministic
checklist.description: The rewrite avoids time, randomness or hidden state so identical inputs give identical outputs.

checklist.name: Plugin treated as orchestration
checklist.description: The explanation says the plugin orchestrates and the transformation belongs in reusable library code.
